# Workflow reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_workflow_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Inputs, secrets, and permissions of each reusable workflow, read from its `workflow_call` block.
A Caller's `permissions:` must grant at least the permissions listed, or GitHub refuses the run.

## Security audit

`uses: mnaimfaizy/agent-kit/.github/workflows/security-audit-reusable.yml@<tag>` — guide: [security-audit.md](security-audit.md)

**Caller permissions:** `contents: read`, `pull-requests: write`, `security-events: write`

| Input                  | Required | Default                            | Description                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `mode`                 | no       | `full`                             | Audit mode: full or pr                                                                                                   |
| `kill_switch`          | no       | `false`                            | If true, skip the audit run.                                                                                             |
| `allowlist_actors`     | no       | `[]`                               | Optional JSON array of allowed actor logins. Empty array skips the check.                                                |
| `threat_model_path`    | yes      | —                                  | Consumer-owned threat pack threat model path.                                                                            |
| `findings_ledger_path` | yes      | —                                  | Consumer-owned findings ledger path.                                                                                     |
| `audit_prompt_path`    | no       | `.github/security-audit/prompt.md` | Path to the audit prompt.                                                                                                |
| `skill_dir`            | no       | `.claude/skills/security-audit`    | Directory of the copied security-audit skill.                                                                            |
| `report_path`          | no       | `.tmp/security-audit-report.md`    | Local path where the generated report is written.                                                                        |
| `scan_command`         | no       | `""`                               | Optional consumer scanner command. Runs in full mode only. Code the job runs: never build it from issue or PR text.      |
| `pr_number`            | no       | `""`                               | PR number for counts-only comment in pr mode.                                                                            |
| `head_sha`             | no       | `""`                               | PR head SHA. Required in pr mode; must be empty in full mode.                                                            |
| `base_sha`             | no       | `""`                               | PR base SHA. Required in pr mode; must be empty in full mode. Trusted commit for the runtime restore and staged scripts. |
| `base_ref`             | no       | `""`                               | PR base branch name. Required in pr mode.                                                                                |
| `model`                | no       | `claude-opus-5`                    | Claude model id. Defaults to claude-opus-5.                                                                              |
| `trigger_label`        | no       | `""`                               | Optional PR label to remove after a pr-mode run.                                                                         |
| `notify_email`         | no       | `false`                            | Send optional email notification.                                                                                        |

| Secret                       | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `advisories_token`           | yes      | Token with repository security advisories write. Not exposed to the agent.                                                                                   |
| `claude_code_oauth_token`    | yes      | Subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token`.                                                                                                          |
| `dependabot_alerts_token`    | no       | Optional fine-grained PAT with Dependabot alerts: read. Full mode grounds on open alerts when set; the job token cannot read them. Not exposed to the agent. |
| `notify_email_to`            | no       | Optional recipient email address.                                                                                                                            |
| `notify_email_from`          | no       | Optional sender email address.                                                                                                                               |
| `notify_email_smtp_host`     | no       | Optional SMTP host.                                                                                                                                          |
| `notify_email_smtp_port`     | no       | Optional SMTP port.                                                                                                                                          |
| `notify_email_smtp_username` | no       | Optional SMTP user.                                                                                                                                          |
| `notify_email_smtp_password` | no       | Optional SMTP password.                                                                                                                                      |

## Implement

`uses: mnaimfaizy/agent-kit/.github/workflows/agent-implement-reusable.yml@<tag>` — guide: [plan-implement-review.md](plan-implement-review.md)

**Caller permissions:** `contents: read`

| Input                  | Required | Default                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kill_switch`          | no       | `false`                   | If true, skip this run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `allowlist_actors`     | no       | `[]`                      | Optional JSON array of allowed actor logins. Empty array skips the check.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `trigger_label`        | no       | `agent:implement`         | Label that triggered this run (for consume step).                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `issue_number`         | yes      | —                         | Issue number to implement.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `planner_marker`       | no       | `<!-- agent-kit-plan -->` | Trusted marker for plan comments.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `trusted_plan_author`  | no       | `github-actions[bot]`     | Expected author login for trusted plan comments.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `base_branch`          | no       | `main`                    | PR base branch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `branch_prefix`        | no       | `claude/`                 | Prefix for the implementer's branch name. Must be a valid start of a branch name, at most 24 characters.                                                                                                                                           |
| `branch_name_template` | no       | `""`                      | claude-code-action branch name template, for example `fix/{{entityNumber}}-{{description}}`. Must contain `{{entityNumber}}`. Empty uses the action's default naming, which the action also falls back to when the template's name already exists. |
| `verify_commands`      | no       | `""`                      | Caller-owned verify commands (multi-line shell). Code the job runs: never build it from issue or PR text.                                                                                                                                          |
| `setup_commands`       | no       | `""`                      | Caller-owned setup run before the agent (toolchain, dependencies). Code the job runs: never build it from issue or PR text.                                                                                                                        |
| `extra_allowed_tools`  | no       | `""`                      | Comma-separated allowedTools entries appended to the reviewed default. An entry that runs repository code (test runner, package manager) bypasses read confinement and acts with the Claude App token; see docs/security-model.md.                 |
| `model`                | no       | `claude-opus-5`           | Claude model id. Defaults to claude-opus-5.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

| Secret                    | Required | Description                                         |
| ------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `claude_code_oauth_token` | yes      | Subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token`. |

## Review

`uses: mnaimfaizy/agent-kit/.github/workflows/agent-review-reusable.yml@<tag>` — guide: [plan-implement-review.md](plan-implement-review.md)

**Caller permissions:** `contents: read`, `issues: read`, `pull-requests: write`, `actions: write`

| Input                       | Required | Default                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `kill_switch`               | no       | `false`                               | If true, skip this run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `allowlist_actors`          | no       | `[]`                                  | Optional JSON array of allowed actor logins. Empty array skips the check.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `trigger_label`             | no       | `agent:review`                        | Label that triggered this run (for consume step).                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pr_number`                 | yes      | —                                     | Pull request number to review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `head_sha`                  | yes      | —                                     | PR head SHA to check out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `base_sha`                  | yes      | —                                     | PR base SHA. Trusted source for the review runtime restore.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `base_ref`                  | yes      | —                                     | PR base branch name. Fetched when the base commit is not already local.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `is_fork`                   | no       | `false`                               | True when the PR head is from a fork. The job no-ops.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `issue_number`              | no       | `""`                                  | Optional issue number used as the spec source when the PR body does not name one.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `planner_marker`            | no       | `<!-- agent-kit-plan -->`             | Trusted marker for plan comments.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `trusted_plan_author`       | no       | `github-actions[bot]`                 | Expected author login for trusted plan comments.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `trusted_spec_authors`      | no       | `[]`                                  | JSON array of logins whose issue comment starting with `<!-- agent-kit-brief -->` is accepted as the spec when there is no Verified plan. Logins match exactly, as GitHub spells them. Empty turns this off; anything but a JSON array of strings fails the review.            |
| `skill_path`                | no       | `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` | Path to the code-review skill, relative to the repository root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `model`                     | no       | `claude-opus-5`                       | Claude model id. Defaults to claude-opus-5.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `response_mode`             | no       | `""`                                  | Callers pass `vars.CLAUDE_REVIEW_RESPONSE_MODE`. Exactly `auto` hands a finished review that left findings to the Review response flow (the Handoff), at most two rounds per pull request. Anything else, or empty, is manual: nothing is handed off.                          |
| `response_workflow`         | no       | `""`                                  | Auto mode only: your Review response Caller, as `.github/workflows/<file>.yml`. The handoff dispatches it on the default branch with the input `pr_number`; its `workflow_dispatch` trigger calls agent-review-response-reusable.yml. Required when `response_mode` is `auto`. |
| `response_allowlist_actors` | no       | `""`                                  | Auto mode only: your Review response Caller's `allowlist_actors`, so the handoff counts the Findings the round will see (an Allowlist reply reopens a Finding an earlier round answered). Empty uses this workflow's `allowlist_actors`.                                       |
| `response_reviewer_logins`  | no       | `[]`                                  | Auto mode only: your Review response Caller's `reviewer_logins`, so the handoff counts the Findings the round will see. Empty means `github-actions`, the kit reviewer, as there.                                                                                              |

| Secret                    | Required | Description                                         |
| ------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `claude_code_oauth_token` | yes      | Subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token`. |

## Review response

`uses: mnaimfaizy/agent-kit/.github/workflows/agent-review-response-reusable.yml@<tag>` — guide: [adr/0005-review-responder-holds-no-write-credential.md](adr/0005-review-responder-holds-no-write-credential.md)

**Caller permissions:** `contents: write`, `pull-requests: write`, `actions: write`

| Input                   | Required | Default                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | -------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kill_switch`           | no       | `false`                | If true, skip this run. Callers pass `vars.CLAUDE_REVIEW_RESPONSE_ENABLED != 'true'`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `allowlist_actors`      | no       | `[]`                   | JSON array of logins allowed to start a round. Their thread replies are also the only Maintainer guidance a round accepts. Empty skips the actor check and accepts guidance from no one.                                                                                                                                        |
| `trigger_label`         | no       | `agent:address-review` | Label that started this run; consumed by the gate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pr_number`             | yes      | —                      | Pull request to respond on. Read live from the API; nothing else is taken from the event.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `reviewer_logins`       | no       | `[]`                   | JSON array of logins whose unresolved review threads are Findings (a trailing `[bot]` is allowed). Empty means `github-actions`, the kit reviewer.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `extra_protected_paths` | no       | `""`                   | Paths from the repository root added to the kit-fixed protected list, one per line or comma-separated. A pull request changing one is refused, and a round may not commit to one. No globs, `!`, `.` or `..`; nothing can be removed from the list.                                                                             |
| `setup_commands`        | no       | `""`                   | Caller-owned setup run before the agent (toolchain, dependencies), as for the implementer; see examples/setup-presets/. npm, pnpm and Yarn 2+ install scripts are always off. Code the job runs: never build it from issue or PR text.                                                                                          |
| `verify_commands`       | no       | `""`                   | Caller-owned checks the agent runs before each fix commit (multi-line shell). The agent's only build command. Code the job runs: never build it from issue or PR text.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `ci_workflow`           | no       | `""`                   | The one workflow whose held `pull_request` run publish may start for the commit it pushed, as `.github/workflows/<file>.yml`. Empty starts none: approve the run from the pull request's checks.                                                                                                                                |
| `response_mode`         | no       | `""`                   | Callers pass `vars.CLAUDE_REVIEW_RESPONSE_MODE`. Exactly `auto` accepts a round dispatched by the review workflow's Handoff (`github-actions[bot]`, on the default branch, at most two rounds per pull request). Anything else, or empty, is manual: every `workflow_dispatch` run is refused and the label is the only way in. |
| `model`                 | no       | `claude-opus-5`        | Claude model id. Defaults to claude-opus-5.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

| Secret                    | Required | Description                                         |
| ------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `claude_code_oauth_token` | yes      | Subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token`. |
